finalText:
**Big but mostly mechanical.** 1291 hits across 94 files.

Four zones must keep `account_id`:

| Zone | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| SQL strings in 25 repo files | 125 | Column name. Needs its own migration first. |
| [migrations/](migrations) | 61 | Applied history. Editing breaks the down step. |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk](vendor/reporting-sdk) | 20 | Regenerated by `npm run vendor:refresh`. |
| [openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) plus WIRE values in [serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | 6 | Frozen public API. |

That leaves about 1075 safe hits. JS params, locals, object keys.

Next: ask them to confirm the rename stops at `serialize`.
